atoms.b: The future perfect tense is used to show that an action will be completed in the ((++future past)).
It is formed with the helping words ((++will_+_have_+_the_past_participle_form go_+_have_+_the_past_participle_form)) of a verb.
atoms.sound: It is formed with the helping words, will, have, and the past participle form of a verb.

instruction.text: What is the correct future perfect tense formula? Fill in the gaps.
Match the verbs with their past participle forms.
Fill in the gaps with the future perfect form of the verb.

hint.text:
Remember: to form the future perfect tense you need the helping words will + have + the past participle form of a verb.

For example:
She will have done the work.
hint.sound: Remember: to form the future perfect tense you need the helping words, will, have, and the past participle form of a verb. For example: She will have done the work.

atoms.b: I ((will_have_slept)) for six hours by the time the alarm rings.
By 1:00pm, they ((will_have_run)) back to class from lunch.
The team ((will_have_won)) the game in a few minutes.
We ((will_have_learnt)) so many new things after this school trip.
We ((will_have_chosen)) which sights to visit by the time we arrive in Rome.
